subject: proving-hall-cases-v2
label: The Proving Hall — reliquary cases, FLAIR pass (counter-top)
notes: RAHEEM'S TWO NOTES, 2026-08-04: (1) 'add some flair, some pop, make them look like they're sparking with magic or crackling or cracked with magic'. (2) 'I would like these set on a beautiful shelf or a counter... I imagine all of these sitting on a counter.'

BOTH NOTES ARE ADDRESSED IN ONE CALL, and that is a deliberate call rather than an oversight. A heavy stone FLOOR plinth sitting on top of a counter reads as two bases stacked. So these are redesigned as COUNTER-TOP reliquaries — smaller, jewel-like, with a slim metal foot instead of a stone block. He explicitly wants them on a counter, so the base has to change with the flair.
THE V1 SET IS KEPT AS FALLBACK. Raheem: 'if it doesn't work, these are not bad.' Nothing is deleted; v1 remains registered and floor-standing if the counter idea is dropped.

FLAIR VOCABULARY, so it is pop and not noise: arcs of energy crackling between the frame and the weapon, cracks of light running through the glass itself, glowing runes etched into the frame, sparks and motes swirling inside. The weapon still FLOATS clear of everything so it stays animatable.
THE WEAPONS REMAIN CANON — Halo Blade (Seraph), Living Staff (Druid), Open-Hand Gauntlets (Monk), Judgment Bow (Seraph), from Archetype_Weapon_and_Companion_Reference.md.
THE BOW IS FIXED. In v1 it read thin inside a large mostly-empty case. Here the case is tighter around it and the bow is drawn larger with its energy string blazing.

PALETTE: the plate's own colours named explicitly — dark iron and TEAL-GREEN frames, honey-amber and brass trim. The teal fittings are the strongest single tell that an object belongs in this courtyard. The magic inside is allowed to be loud, and its colours come from the game's element art: nature green rgb(77,120,70), light gold rgb(202,168,76), spirit sky-blue rgb(115,175,206), holy gold rgb(193,144,84).
NO BAKED GROUND, and now also NO STONE PLINTH — these sit on a counter that is its own asset. No floor tile, no paving, no square backing panel.

objects.note: Same four relics, but counter-top scale and crackling with magic. Silhouette variety kept — tall narrow, tight wide, small square, tall wide.
